title: QUESTION: should a signature-proven current listing beat an earlier unproven retired listing of a key?
description: From vouch-ey47.13 review (finding on key ownership). DESIGN/vouch-omzm settle retired-key ownership as 'first commit listing it'. A person may list any key as retired with no proof by that key, so someone who lists a victim's key first (in an ancestor commit, e.g. after review lets it through) owns it and the victim's later proven listing is the error. Concurrent listings are now tied and the current (proven) listing wins. Reviewer suggests giving unproven retired listings no priority at all. Not implemented: it changes a recorded design decision.
